column2: I could get behind this AI. I hope they sit in one of the 24h ground steamed warm tomato greenhouses,  eating that wierd lamb flatbread I was served. Or Puffin.

I wonder why Iceland thinks they still need to promote their tourism, they get tons of them already. I guess it's because of capitalism, and economic competition.

I was there 2 years ago (and previously in 2019). I had a realization that maybe 80% of the car traffic are tourists (number pulled out of a volcanic vent) going from one tourist spot to the next. I realized this while sitting in a crossover SUV with 4 empty seats.

The roads into Reykjavik have traffic jams now, probably an oddity for a place of 140k.

Icelanders obviosly laugh at themselves first and a lot, so rolling out another joke for a specific occasion is just something they do, a lot.
 AI is like bieng a kid again, when your parents start trying to force some new thing on you and are acting all WIERD huddling up whispering to each other and there friends, cause they all fucked up and into WHO KNOWS WHAT, except it's everybodys boss and you have to play along with doing the "extra curricular activities" whether you like them or not. There must be many poor souls who are bieng pushed into AI, not just by there boss, but by there parrents as well.
 Icelands looking better by the second.
